name: 6-Inch Multi-Position Fill Light | Selfie Ring Light with Tripod Stand & Phone Holder | 3 Color Modes | USB Powered | Multicolor
description:
Enhance your photos, videos, and live streams with the 6-Inch Multi-Position Fill Light. Featuring three lighting modes and adjustable brightness levels, this compact ring light delivers professional-quality lighting for makeup, video recording, online classes, live broadcasting, and content creation. Its adjustable tripod stand and phone holder provide stable support, while the USB-powered design ensures convenient use anywhere.

Key Features
6-inch LED ring light with adjustable tripod stand
Three lighting modes: Cool White, Warm White, and Daylight
Ten brightness levels for customized lighting
Ideal for live streaming, makeup, selfies, and video recording
Adjustable tripod height for different shooting angles
Includes phone holder and ball head mount
USB-powered design for convenient use
Compact, lightweight, and portable
Helps reduce shadows and improve image quality
Suitable for indoor and outdoor use

Product Specifications
Product Type: Selfie Ring Light with Tripod Stand
Ring Light Size: 6 Inches
Light Modes: Cool White, Warm White, Daylight
Brightness Levels: 10 Adjustable Levels
Power Source: USB
Stand Type: Adjustable Tripod Stand

How to Use
Connect the ring light to a USB power source
Attach your smartphone to the holder
Adjust the tripod height and angle
Select your preferred lighting mode and brightness
Start recording, streaming, or taking photos

Material / Composition
ABS Plastic
LED Light Components
Metal Tripod Stand
Electronic Components

Safety Information
Keep away from water and moisture
Do not use damaged USB cables
Avoid excessive bending of the tripod
Keep out of reach of children
Store in a cool and dry place

Package Includes
